ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager guesses the weather out loud every morning, and today a friend says the guess is wrong.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Every morning, before (subject.he/she) has even sat up, (subject) guesses the weather out loud. "Sunny, with a little wind after lunch." Then (subject.he/she) scratches a mark on the wall: a line if (subject.he/she) was right, a dot if (subject.he/she) was wrong. After years of this, the wall is about half lines and half dots. Today (friend) hears the guess and says, "No. Rain by midday."

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They shake on it. All morning both of them keep glancing at the sky. At midday there isn't a cloud anywhere. (subject) is very gracious about winning. Then, just after lunch, a single small cloud drifts over and drops about nine raindrops directly on (subject)'s head. They argue happily all evening about who won. The wall gets a line and a dot.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) just smiles and says nothing. The day turns out sunny, with a little wind after lunch. That evening (subject.he/she) scratches a line on the wall, then, after a moment, a tiny extra mark next to it, which is (subject.his/her) private way of saying "and (friend) was wrong." (subject.He/She) has never been so pleased with a mark in (subject.his/her) life.
